collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A soft morning fog hides the far end of the village.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: A soft morning fog hides the far end of the village. Voices drift through it, and (name1) tries to guess who is speaking.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: A soft morning fog hides the far end of the village. (name1) walks into the fog and finds the village feels quieter inside it.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: A soft morning fog hides the far end of the village. The fog lifts all at once, and the huts appear as if from nowhere.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: A soft morning fog hides the far end of the village. Someone greets a tree, thinking it is a neighbor, and laughs at the mistake.
